info.name: Tyk Dashboard Admin Additional Permissions Certificates API

params.name: p
params.description: Use p query parameter to say which page you want returned. Send number less than 0 to return all items.

params.name: mode
params.description: Set to detailed to get certificates that are more with more details (Will contains certs basic details). To retrieve a list of certificates with all the certificate details use [this endpoint](#operation/listDetailedCertificates).

items.docs: Return list of certificates. If you send the mode query parameter with the value `detailed` the certificates returned will have more information (Will contains all certs basic details). To retrieve a list with complete certificate details use [this endpoint](#operation/listDetailedCertificates). If the mode query parameter is omitted or is empty this endpoint will only return the certificates IDs. The list of certificates returned is paginated.

info.name: Create a certificate in Tyk org cert store.

items.docs: Upload new SSL certificate in PEM format (you should upload as a file). If the certificate should have a private key, convert both the public certificate and the associated private key to PEM format and concatenate them to a single file. You can only upload one certificate at a time.

params.name: certId
params.description: ID of the certificate you want to fetch.

items.docs: Get a single certificate details with the certificate's ID.

params.name: certId
params.description: ID of the certificate you want to delete.

params.name: certId
params.description: ID of the certificate you want to fetch dependencies for.

items.docs: This will return the API IDs and API names of all APIs that uses this certificates as either upstream certificates or as client certificates.

params.name: certId
params.description: ID of the certificate you want to delete dependencies for.

items.docs: This endpoint will remove the certificates from any APIs that contains it as an upstream certificates or as a client certificate. It will also remove any key that uses this certificate.

params.name: p
params.description: Use p query parameter to say which page you want returned. Send number less than 0 to return all items.

items.docs: Return a list that contains certificates and their full details.
